entries.description: Connect your Amp subscription through the amp-acp adapter.
entries.modelSelectionHint: Use the Amp CLI to configure models
setupSteps: Install the Amp CLI: `curl -fsSL https://ampcode.com/install.sh | bash`
Install the ACP adapter: `npm install -g amp-acp`
Ensure your Amp CLI is authenticated (run `amp` to verify)

Add to the Epistemos compatibility config (`~/.config/goose/config.yaml` on macOS/Linux):
  GOOSE_PROVIDER: amp-acp
  GOOSE_MODEL: current
  amp-acp_configured: true
Restart Epistemos for changes to take effect

entries.description: Local models through Atomic Chat’s OpenAI-compatible server
Cost-effective inference API with DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, and MiniMax models

Run models through Amazon Bedrock. Supports AWS SSO profiles - run 'aws sso login --profile <profile-name>' before using. Configure with AWS_PROFILE and AWS_REGION, use environment variables/credentials, or use AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK for bearer token authentication. Region is required for bearer token auth (can be set via AWS_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, or AWS profile). Prompt caching can be enabled for Anthropic Claude models by setting BEDROCK_ENABLE_CACHING=true. Responses stream via the ConverseStream API; set BEDROCK_DISABLE_STREAMING=true to fall back to blocking Converse calls.
Models through Azure OpenAI Service (supports API key, Entra ID bearer token, and Azure credential chain)
